en: Colorized historic postcard view of a large stone fortress-like building with a massive round tower in the foreground and a rectangular multi‑story block attached. In the background, a church spire rises above the roofline. There is a grassy field in front with a small path and a few tiny human figures. Printed German text at the top reads the location and the specific building.
